item.description: The Transport Ministry has commenced the process to acquire buses for the second phase of the Rural School Bus System. item.title: Opposition calls on PM to clarify the status of the Morant Bay Urban Centre following reports that the centre remains incomplete
item.description: The Opposition has called on Prime Minister Dr. Andrew Holness to clarify the status of the Morant Bay Urban Centre in St. Thomas. Spokesperson on Trade, Industry and Global Logistics, Anthony Hylton pointed to reports that the centre remains incomplete and inaccessible to tenants, nearly a year after Dr. Holness officially opened it last year April. item.title: New mobile application designed to strengthen oversight and accountability in mining sector launched yesterday
item.description: Developed by the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners, the Mining Matters Mobile App, aims to give residents a stronger voice in reporting mining concerns. Speaking at the launch, Agriculture Minister Floyd Green said the platform will allow citizens to submit reports directly to the authorities, improving transparency and response times across the sector.
